answer: Each new identity must lock 10,000 POA for two full epochs, and only seals from already-established peers count toward unlocking that bond. A fresh cluster cannot attest itself into standing. If five established graders seal that two addresses submitted near-duplicate answers (token Jaccard ≥ 0.90) in the same epoch, both bonds are slashed and lose grading weight. To forge many identities an attacker pays 10,000 POA per seat, waits through a dune of delayed unlocks, and needs unaffiliated attesters. The pearl is on-ledger and recheckable: bond tx, unique attester set, and slash threshold.
